messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — P0: gpu-pool-3 experiencing widespread container crashloops (segfaults) on runtime v2. Immediate escalation to eng-runtime. Auto-pager: sam_oncall, kevin_runtime. Logged at 1809992468.

sam_oncall: Got the page, jumping in. Observed spike in 5xx for hosted endpoints in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. CPU fine, GPU mem trending near 100% then segfault.

kevin_runtime: I’m seeing consistent SIGSEGV in the runtime process inside the container:
```
[2026-03-15T14:07:02Z] runtime: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c1a2f3abc sp 0x7ffea3b7e0 error 4
#0 0x7f8c1a2f3abc in tensorcore_conv_fused::forward()+0x1b
#1 0x7f8c1a257000 in vllm::Engine::step()+0x3c4
#2 0x55a4b8c0 in main_loop()
```
Crashes point into a custom fused tensorcore kernel (tensorcore_conv_fused) — looks like a boundary condition in async kernel launch.

maria_eng: Any recent deploys? I see a canary rolled at 13:50 that enabled fused-kernel=on and a TRT-LLM upgrade on the dedicated pool.

jordan_sre: Pod events (snippet):
```
Events:
  Warning  FailedCreatePodSandBox  1m (x12 over 6m)  kubelet  Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to setup network for sandbox "...": failed to connect: context deadline exceeded
  Normal   Killing                 1m  kubelet  Killing container with id docker://runtime: Container failed liveness probe
```
But the container itself is OOM-ing then segfaulting. Not pure network.

kevin_runtime: Trying to reproduce on a repro node. Running a small load with model-llm-v2 (fp16, tensorcore fused). If I force disable fused kernels (env DISABLE_FUSED=1) the crash does not occur. With fused=1 reproduces within ~20s.

sam_oncall: For mitigation: 1) scale down replicas of model-llm-v2 on hosted pool; 2) disable fused kernels via env override for the pool; 3) cordon and drain one noisy node for deeper inspection; 4) contact CS for customer impact. Who will run these?

jordan_sre: I can cordon/drain the two most affected nodes (gpu-pool-3-node-7, node-8) and shift traffic. Running: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-3-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-pool-3-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

ops-lead: Hold on scaling down — we need an immediate fallback to a compatible model variant to keep availability. Suggest route policy: route traffic to model-llm-v1-small and set autoscaler to absorb. I’ll coordinate with routing.

kevin_runtime: I’m preparing a hot rollback to the pre-canary runtime binary with fused disabled by default. Patch candidate: set ENV FUSED_KERNELS=0 and roll the runtime daemonset for gpu-pool-3. Also building a debug image with gdb symbols.

maria_eng: Support-bot, please post a health notice to status page and mark impacted regions us-west-2, eu-west-1. Sara, can you prep a short CS blurb?

support-bot: Status page draft posted: "Degraded performance and 5xx errors for hosted inference in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Working on mitigation."

sara_custsuccess: Drafted customer message: "We're investigating increased errors affecting inference in US-West and EU-West. We're actively mitigating; you may see 5xx for some requests. We'll update in 30 minutes or on resolution." Posting to affected customers with SLA watchers.

kevin_runtime: Live debug notes: attached gdb backtrace from repro container (trimmed):
```
#0  tensorcore_conv_fused::forward() at fused_ops.cu:412
412       memcpyAsync(...);
#1  vllm::Engine::step() at engine.cc:289
289       kernel_launch(...);
```
I suspect a race in memcpyAsync and kernel launch ordering under high concurrency — leads to illegal device memory access.

sam_oncall: Plan for next 20m:
- jordan_sre to cordon/drain noisy nodes (in flight)
- kevin_runtime to push runtime hot-rollback with FUSED_KERNELS=0 to gpu-pool-3 (canary rollout 50%)
- ops-lead to modify routing to steer to v1-small for critical customers
- sara_custsuccess to send customer update

jordan_sre: Cordon/drain done for node-7 and node-8, pods drained to other nodes. Observed reduced crashrate on those nodes.

kevin_runtime: Kicking hot-rollback now: `kubectl set env ds/runtime FUSED_KERNELS=0 -n hosted --record && kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime -n hosted` Rolling 50% canary to gpu-pool-3 first.

incident-bot: Action logged: runtime hot-rollback started by kevin_runtime at 1809992580.

kevin_runtime: Canary looks good for 5m — no segfaults in canary pods. Proceeding to 100% roll within pool.

ops-lead: Routing change applied — critical customer rings moved to model-llm-v1-small. Observed error rate drop from 14% -> 3% for critical routes.

maria_eng: Any signs of underlying driver or hardware issue? NV driver versions across nodes are consistent (540.xx). I’ll schedule a deeper kernel/driver repro on a spare node.

kevin_runtime: We’ll open a ticket to revert the fused kernel implementation and add stricter synchronization around async memcpy. Also to add a guard: disable fused when GPU mem > 90% to prevent this class of failure.

sam_oncall: Customer impact summary to include in postmortem:
- Affected regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1
- Impact: 5xxs and latency spikes, roughly 8% of hosted requests for a ~25 minute window before full rollback; critical customers saw intermittent failures, rerouted to fallback models.
- Root cause (prelim): race condition in custom fused tensorcore kernel triggered under high-concurrency / high-memory conditions.

sara_custsuccess: Sent follow-up to impacted customers with mitigation and ETA for next update (postmortem within 48 hours).

jordan_sre: Collected core dumps and kernel logs from drained nodes. Uploading artifacts to the incident bucket: `gs://redwood-incidents/1809992468/`

kevin_runtime: Patch branch created: `fix/fused-memcpy-sync` with tests; will submit PR and request expedited review. Also adding canary gating in deploy pipeline for fused kernels.

incident-bot: Pager cleared: incident moved to SEV-1->SEV-Resolved state at 1809992735. Please file a postmortem and link artifacts.

sam_oncall: Marking handoff: I’m handing back to oncall rotation for follow-ups. Thanks everyone — good coordination.

ops-lead: Summary note: short-term mitigation = disable fused kernels in runtime; medium-term = sync fixes + gating; long-term = add model-level fallback and mem-based guard.

kevin_runtime: Final action items recorded: 1) PR and tests for memcpy sync; 2) postmortem with timeline and customer impact; 3) add deploy gate for fused kernels; 4) add mem threshold guard.

sara_custsuccess: Postmortem email queued for 48h with customer-facing summary.

maria_eng: Leaving logs + gdb traces in the incident folder and linking to the ticket. Closing thread after postmortem published. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Incident artifact links: `gs://redwood-incidents/1809992468/` `http://internal.reports/incident/1809992468`

sam_oncall: Closed — will follow up on the postmortem actions tomorrow. :thumbsup:
